note: Full City of Toronto shelter census table scraped daily from toronto.ca/shelter-census. Each entry is an array of rows keyed by BonQuery sector key, matching the schema of city_reference_2026-05-14.json (key, label, section, col_type, city_ind, city_occ, city_unocc, city_cap, city_rate). Available from 2026-07-28 onward. Days where the City did not publish a table (weekends, holidays) will be absent unless the City retroactively posts catch-up tables on a subsequent day.
